lines.en: Lesson 3
lines.zh: 第3课

lines.en: Matterhorn man
lines.zh: 马特洪峰人

lines.en: What was the main objective of early mountain climbers?
lines.zh: 早期登山者的主要目标是什么？

lines.en: Modern alpinists try to climb mountains by a route which will give them good sport,
lines.zh: 现代登山者尝试通过一条能给他们带来良好体验的路线攀登山脉，

lines.en: and the more difficult it is, the more highly it is regarded.
lines.zh: 越是困难，就越受推崇。

lines.en: In the pioneering days however, this was not the case at all.
lines.zh: 然而，在开创时期，情况并非如此。

lines.en: The early climbers were looking for the easiest way to the top because the summit was the prize they sought,
lines.zh: 早期登山者寻找最容易登顶的路线，因为山顶是他们追求的奖品，

lines.en: especially if it had never been attained before.
lines.zh: 尤其是在从未有人登顶过的情况下。

lines.en: It is true that during their explorations they often faced difficulties and dangers of the most perilous nature,
lines.zh: 诚然，在他们的探险过程中，他们经常面临最危险性质的困难和危险，

lines.en: equipped in a manner which would make a modern climber shudder at the thought,
lines.zh: 他们所装备的方式会让现代登山者不寒而栗，

lines.en: but they did not go out of their way to court such excitement.
lines.zh: 但他们并没有刻意追求这种刺激。

lines.en: They had a single aim, a solitary goal -- the top!
lines.zh: 他们只有一个目的，一个唯一的目标——顶峰！

lines.en: It is hard for us to realize nowadays how difficult it was for the pioneers.
lines.zh: 如今我们很难体会到先驱们当时所面临的困难。

lines.en: Except for one or two places such as Zermatt and Chamonix, which had rapidly become popular.
lines.zh: 除了采尔马特和霞慕尼等一两个迅速变得受欢迎的地方，

lines.en: Alpine villages tended to be impoverished settlements cut off from civilization by the high mountains.
lines.zh: 高山村庄往往是贫困的定居点，被高山与文明隔绝。

lines.en: Such inns as there were were generally dirty and flea-ridden;
lines.zh: 那些仅有的旅馆通常肮脏且跳蚤遍布；

lines.en: the food simply local cheese accompanied by bread often twelve months old,
lines.zh: 食物只是当地的奶酪，配上通常存放了十二个月的面包，

lines.en: all washed down with coarse wine.
lines.zh: 所有这些都用粗劣的葡萄酒冲下。

lines.en: Often a valley boasted no inn at all, and climbers found shelter wherever they could --
lines.zh: 通常一个山谷根本没有旅馆，登山者只好尽其所能寻找住处——

lines.en: sometimes with the local priest (who was usually as poor as his parishioners),
lines.zh: 有时是和当地的牧师（他们通常和教区居民一样贫穷），

lines.en: sometimes with shepherds or cheese-makers.
lines.zh: 有时是和牧羊人或奶酪制造者。

lines.en: Invariably the background was the same:dirt and poverty, and very uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 背景总是相同的：肮脏和贫困，而且非常不舒服。

lines.en: For men accustomed to eating seven-course dinners and sleeping between fine linen sheets at home,
lines.zh: 对于在家中习惯享用七道菜晚餐并睡在精细亚麻床单之间的人来说，

lines.en: the change to the Alps must have been very hard indeed.
lines.zh: 这种阿尔卑斯山的生活转变一定非常艰难。
